candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so the stored timestamp no longer updates after a successful call.
Replace `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime)` with `require(block.timestamp >= pastBlockTime)` so multiple calls within the same block are allowed, changing pastBlockTime's observable value.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp` with `pastBlockTime = block.number` so the stored value is a block number instead of a timestamp.
Change the payout condition from `block.number % 15 == 0` to `block.number % 15 != 0`, inverting when the contract pays out.
Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether) check so any nonzero value is accepted.
Delete the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) check so multiple calls in the same block are allowed.
Delete the pastBlockTime update so the state variable no longer records the last block timestamp.
Invert the payout condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to != 0.
Delete the statement `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so the tracked timestamp is never updated.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so a different value is recorded in the state variable.
Delete the statement updating pastBlockTime so it stays 0 and is observable via its public getter.
Replace the update of pastBlockTime with block.number so the stored value differs from the original timestamp value.
Invert the payout condition so refunds occur when block.number % 15 != 0, changing when the contract's balance is paid out.
Move the assignment pastBlockTime = block.timestamp after the payout block so pastBlockTime is not updated when the call reverts on transfer.
